name: crosscheck
description: Plays invented games through both engines and reports the first disagreement (spec 0010).

scripts.check: cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path checker/Cargo.toml && node tools/bundle.mjs && node node_modules/.crosscheck/cli.mjs check
scripts.replay: cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path checker/Cargo.toml && node tools/bundle.mjs && node node_modules/.crosscheck/cli.mjs replay
